title: Arab Countries Condemn Houthi Attempt to Target Saudi Arabia's Madinah Region
detail: A Google News-aggregated headline reports that Arab countries condemned an alleged Houthi attempt to target Saudi Arabia's Madinah region. Only the headline was available; the weapon used, whether it was intercepted, the condemning states and any Houthi response are unconfirmed.

title: Saudi-Led Coalition Says It Intercepted a Drone in the Riyadh Region
detail: A Google News-aggregated headline reports the Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted a drone in the Riyadh region. Only the headline was available; the launch origin, drone type and any attribution are unconfirmed.
